Installation and execution¶

Prerequisites¶

  • Python 3.10+ recommended.

  • Java runtime compatible with the installed PySpark version for local Spark.

  • AWS CLI for AWS deployment/testing.

  • An AWS account with permissions for S3, Glue, Athena, and IAM when using the cloud path.

Create a virtual environment¶

Windows PowerShell:

python -m venv .venv
.venv\Scripts\Activate.ps1

Windows CMD:

python -m venv .venv
.venv\Scripts\activate

Linux/macOS:

python -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate

Install project dependencies¶

pip install -r requirements.txt

Run the local pipeline¶

python scripts/run_local_pipeline.py

This creates curated CSV files under data/curated_local/.

Run the FastAPI service¶

uvicorn src.api.main:app --reload

The interactive API documentation is then available from the FastAPI development server.

Run the Streamlit dashboard¶

streamlit run src/dashboard/app.py

Run tests¶

pytest -q

Environment configuration¶

Copy .env.example to .env and provide the AWS values required by the S3 helper. Do not commit real credentials or secrets.

Build this Sphinx documentation¶

Install Sphinx and the HTML theme:

pip install sphinx sphinx-rtd-theme

From the project root:

sphinx-build -b html docs docs/_build/html

Open the generated documentation:

Windows:

start docs\_build\html\index.html

Linux:

xdg-open docs/_build/html/index.html

macOS:

open docs/_build/html/index.html

Live-reload development¶

For automatic rebuilds while editing documentation:

pip install sphinx-autobuild
sphinx-autobuild docs docs/_build/html

Then open the local URL printed by the command.
